svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How Folio works
svg.desc: An animated diagram in five scenes. 1: you type, and the resume is saved in your own browser. 2: an AI button sends only that text to an API route on Vercel, which checks the daily limit in Upstash Redis, asks Groq, and sends the answer back. 3: PDF and Word files are made in the browser. 4: errors go through Folio's own /sentry-tunnel to Sentry, without resume text. 5: every push to GitHub runs CI, then deploys to Vercel.

g.text: Every change saves in your own browser. Resumes are never stored on a server.
Only that text goes out. The daily limit is checked, Groq rewords it, and it comes back.
The PDF or Word file is made right in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
An error report goes through Folio's own tunnel to Sentry. Never your resume text.
CI runs lint, types, 259 unit tests and 56 browser and accessibility tests, then deploys.

svg.text: type, or edit right on the page
Page, Score, ATS check, Job match
rewords your words, adds no facts
